classes.label: Patient

classes.label: SaO2
classes.definition: Core BrainIT parameter. Arterial oxygen saturation by Pulse Oximetry.

classes.label: Temperature
classes.definition: Core BrainIT parameter. Source: rectal, oesophageal, bladder, or skin.

classes.label: CVP
classes.definition: Central Venous Pressure. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: EtCO2
classes.definition: End-tidal CO2. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: SjO2
classes.definition: Jugular venous oxygen saturation. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: TCD
classes.definition: Transcranial Doppler. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: Brain Temperature
classes.definition: Cerebral temperature. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: Microdialysis
classes.definition: Cerebral microdialysis. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: Peripheral Temperature
classes.definition: Peripheral (skin/tympanic) temperature. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: Cardiac Output
classes.definition: Cardiac output monitoring. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: NIBP
classes.definition: Non-invasive blood pressure. Optional BrainIT parameter.

classes.label: Fluids

classes.label: Nutrition

classes.label: Noradrenaline

classes.label: Adrenaline
classes.definition: Adrenaline (epinephrine).

classes.label: Secondary Insult Treatment

classes.label: Decompressive Craniectomy
classes.definition: Decompressive craniectomy to relieve intracranial pressure.

classes.label: Hypertension
classes.definition: Elevated blood pressure.

classes.label: Clinical Assessment
classes.definition: Structured clinical evaluation performed at admission and during the ICU stay.

classes.label: CT Scan Assessment
classes.definition: CT scan classification using TCDB nomenclature.

classes.label: Blood Gases
classes.definition: Arterial blood gas analysis.

classes.label: Nursing Intervention
classes.definition: Routine nursing care, physiotherapy, or bedside clinical activities.

classes.label: Intensive Care Management
classes.definition: ICU management data category.

classes.label: Observation
classes.definition: A single measurement or reading recorded at a Timepoint for a given Parameter.

classes.label: Parameter
classes.definition: A physiological or clinical variable that is measured and recorded.

classes.label: Possible Error
classes.definition: PoE: a reading outside acceptable range that is contextually explained.

classes.label: Probable Error
classes.definition: PrE: a reading outside its acceptable range with no contextual clinical explanation.
